title: Autumnal American Apple Salad
description: A refreshing autumnal salad featuring crisp apples, mixed greens, and a hint of sweetness.

ingredients.name: Autumnal Greens
ingredients.notes: Mixed greens with kale, spinach, and arugula

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the autumnal greens.
2. Arrange the braeburn apple slices on top of the greens.
3. Sprinkle the diced crispy bacon over the apples.
4. Drizzle the apple cider vinaigrette over the salad.
5. Toss the salad gently to combine.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
